events.name: Delta Research Week
events.description: Strange readings across the regions: find clues at events, win research battles and study rare Pokémon.
events.ruleText: Rare Pokémon turn up 50% more often; mysteries and odd signals appear on the map more often.

events.name: Rivalry Week
events.description: Old rivals are back and hungrier than ever. Beat them, and keep winning.
events.ruleText: Rivals come back 2 levels stronger; rival rematches appear on the map more often.

events.name: Gym Circuit
events.description: Tour the gyms under tournament rules: the leaders hit harder, and every badge counts.
events.ruleText: Boss Pokémon deal 15% more damage; gym scouts and ambushes appear more often.

events.name: Egg Expedition
events.description: Breeders are out in force: travel far, catch plenty and watch your team grow.
events.ruleText: Your Pokémon gain 15% more experience; nests, breeders and daycares appear more often.

events.name: Catch Carnival
events.description: Every ball is a lucky ball this week. Catch, keep and catch some more.
events.ruleText: Poké Balls work 25% better; swarms and the Safari Zone appear more often.

objectives.text: Keep 5 caught Pokémon in your party

events.name: Raid Rally
events.description: Giant Pokémon are stirring in dens and territories everywhere. Field medics stand by.
events.ruleText: Healing items restore 25% more HP; sleeping giants and alpha Pokémon appear more often.

events.name: Dragon Week
events.description: Dragons gather at the old shrines. Face them, or fly with them.
events.ruleText: Dragon moves deal 20% more damage and Dragon-types appear twice as often.

objectives.text: Beat a boss with a Dragon-type leading

events.name: Market Week
events.description: The merchants are in town: everything is 10% off, and the deals are everywhere.
events.ruleText: Shop prices are 10% lower; sales and bazaars appear more often.

events.name: Champion's Gauntlet
events.description: The League is holding open trials. Enemies are a little tougher, and prize money is richer.
events.ruleText: Enemy Pokémon are 1 level higher; prize money is 20% higher.

events.name: Legendary Beasts Chase
events.description: Raikou, Entei and Suicune are roaming the region. Follow their trail, and be ready when they turn to face you.
events.ruleText: Raikou, Entei and Suicune roam every map from the third stage, moving as you do; tracks and sightings turn up on the road.

events.name: Campfire Tales
events.description: Storytellers are out and the fires are lit. Every stop is a chance to hear, or tell, a story.
events.ruleText: Storytellers, ghost stories and Pokémon memories turn up at camps and on the road; your Pokémon bond faster at rest.

events.name: Team Plasma Liberation Operation
events.description: Team Plasma is taking Pokémon again. Cut their supply routes, free the captives and face the commander.
events.ruleText: Three stops follow the operation from the supply route to the holding yard to the commander; what you do early changes the later fights.

events.name: Hidden Path Week
events.description: The secret branches of every route are open for a week. Pokémon with the right ability can find them.
events.ruleText: Secret paths show themselves more often; path keepers, signposts and shortcuts turn up on the road.

objectives.text: Beat or best a Path Keeper

events.name: Mystery Dungeon Week
events.description: A stair appears on the road that leads down to a dungeon whose rooms change every time. Take what you can and leave before your luck runs out.
events.ruleText: A Mystery Dungeon opens on the road: three floors, new rooms each time, traps, shops, monster houses and a boss.

objectives.text: Beat the Dungeon Boss or Pack

events.name: Tower of Legends
events.description: The Tower of Legends opens its doors to everyone. Five floors, each a different test, and a Legend at the top.
events.ruleText: The Tower of Legends has a door on every road: five floors that test resources, team, battle and endurance, with a Legendary at the top.

objectives.text: Beat the Legend at the top

events.name: Spooky Season
events.description: The Spooky pack: haunted stops, Spooky forms in the wild, the Pumpkin King and the Midnight Parade.
events.ruleText: About 1 in 7 wild Pokémon turn into Spooky forms and Ghost-types appear twice as often; Spooky stops appear on the map.

objectives.text: Beat a special boss (the Pumpkin King)
Win the final encounter (the Midnight Parade)

events.name: Harvest Festival
events.description: Farmers bring in the harvest: berries, fairs and well-fed Pokémon.
events.ruleText: Healing items restore 20% more HP and Grass-types appear 50% more often.

objectives.text: Find 4 clues at the Berry Fair and harvest stops

events.name: Winter Festival
events.description: Snow, lights and gifts for everyone. The Frost King waits on the road.
events.ruleText: Ice moves deal 15% more damage, Ice-types appear twice as often and prize money is 10% higher.

objectives.text: Swap 4 gifts (clues at the Gift Exchange)

events.name: New Year Countdown
events.description: Ring in the new year with fireworks, wishes and one last big battle.
events.ruleText: Prize money is 25% higher; your Pokémon gain 10% more experience.

events.name: Lantern Festival
events.description: Red lanterns, dragon dances and lucky envelopes for the Lunar New Year.
events.ruleText: Fire and Dragon moves deal 10% more damage; prize money is 15% higher.

objectives.text: Light 3 lanterns (clues on the Lantern Walk)

events.name: Friendship Festival
events.description: A festival of hearts: picnics, sweets and teams that stick together.
events.ruleText: Your Pokémon gain 50% more friendship; Fairy-types appear 50% more often.

objectives.text: Keep 6 caught Pokémon in your party

events.name: Anniversary Week
events.description: Celebrate where it all began: starters, parades and old friends.
events.ruleText: Your Pokémon gain 15% more experience and your starter deals 10% more damage.

objectives.text: Clear a region with your starter still in the party

events.name: Spring Bloom
events.description: Flowers open, eggs hide in the meadows and the Bloom Guardian wakes.
events.ruleText: Grass and Fairy-types appear 50% more often; Poké Balls work 10% better.

objectives.text: Find 5 eggs (clues at the Egg Hunt)

events.name: Earth Week
events.description: Clean up the routes and meet the Pokémon of rock, earth and forest.
events.ruleText: Ground, Rock and Grass-types appear 50% more often; research pays 20% more.

events.name: Summer Splash
events.description: Beaches, tide pools and the biggest beach tournament of the year.
events.ruleText: Water moves deal 15% more damage and Water-types appear twice as often.

events.name: Stargazing Nights
events.description: Meteor showers light the sky. Rare Pokémon come out to watch.
events.ruleText: Rare Pokémon turn up 50% more often and your Hyper moments come twice as often.

events.name: Trainer Academy
events.description: Back to school! Exams on the road, study halls and tougher trainers.
events.ruleText: Research pays 25% more; trainers are 1 level higher.

events.name: Great Berry Festival
events.description: A spring berry festival: stalls, contests, thieves, a guardian tree and a berry research tent. Plant, harvest and breed rare berries.
events.ruleText: Berries heal 20% more, Grass-types appear 30% more often, and the festival stops (stalls, contest, thief, grove, research tent) join the map.

objectives.text: Find 4 clues at the festival stops

events.name: Fire Week
events.description: Embers on every road. Fire-types are out in force and burns spread fast.
events.ruleText: Fire-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. Burns from your Fire moves land twice as often.

events.name: Water Week
events.description: The tide is in. Water-types fill the routes and rain keeps falling.
events.ruleText: Water-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. Your Water moves hit 15% harder in rain. A tide meter rises by 1 at every map stop (0 to 4, then it falls back to low); at high tide (3 or 4) your Water moves deal 25% more damage.

events.name: Grass Week
events.description: Overgrown routes and herb stalls: Grass-types and plenty of healing.
events.ruleText: Grass-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. Healing items restore 25% more HP.

events.name: Electric Week
events.description: Static in the air. Electric-types spark and paralysis spreads.
events.ruleText: Electric-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. Paralysis from your Electric moves lands 50% more often. Charge builds by 1 after every won battle (up to 5), carries between battles, and adds 4% Electric damage per point.

events.name: Ice Week
events.description: Frozen lakes and cold snaps: Ice-types roam and your hail lasts.
events.ruleText: Ice-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. Hail starts every fight (5 turns) and weather your side sets up lasts 2 turns longer.

events.name: Fighting Week
events.description: Dojos on every road. Fighters train hard and never quite go down.
events.ruleText: Fighting-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. A fatal hit leaves your Fighting-types at 1 HP 30% of the time (once per battle, like a Focus Sash).

events.name: Poison Week
events.description: A toxic swamp season: Poison-types everywhere and status cures are cheap.
events.ruleText: Poison-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. Poison damage you inflict is 50% stronger; Full Heals cost half.

events.name: Ground Week
events.description: The earth shakes and the diggers are out.
events.ruleText: Ground-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. Prize money is 10% higher (what the diggers turn up).

events.name: Flying Week
events.description: Clear skies and strong wings: Flying-types are hard to pin down.
events.ruleText: Flying-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. Enemy accuracy against your Flying-types is divided by 1.2.

events.name: Psychic Week
events.description: Whispers in the mind: the map shows what waits ahead.
events.ruleText: Psychic-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. The map shows the wild Pokémon waiting at each node.

events.name: Bug Week
events.description: The Bug Catching Contest is on: Bug-types swarm and catching pays.
events.ruleText: Bug-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. Prize money after a catch is 50% higher.

events.name: Rock Week
events.description: Hardhats and fossil digs in every cave.
events.ruleText: Rock-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. Your Rock-types have 10% more Defense.

events.name: Ghost Week
events.description: The routes feel haunted. Ghost-types drift in and out of sight.
events.ruleText: Ghost-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage.

events.name: Dark Week
events.description: Night falls early and Dark-types prowl the roads.
events.ruleText: Dark-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. Prize money is 10% higher.

events.name: Steel Week
events.description: Forge fires burn on every road; held items are worked to a finer edge.
events.ruleText: Steel-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. Held-item bonuses are 25% stronger; your Steel-types have 10% more Defense.

events.name: Fairy Week
events.description: Fairy rings in every meadow charm wild Pokémon.
events.ruleText: Fairy-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. Poké Balls work 15% better and Pokémon gain 25% more friendship.

events.name: Normal Week
events.description: Plain and proud: Normal-types stand taller than usual.
events.ruleText: Normal-types appear twice as often and their moves deal 10% more damage. Your Normal-types have 10% more Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk and Sp. Def.

events.name: Dragon Hatchling Week
events.description: Baby Dragons hatch all over the routes and grow fast.
events.ruleText: Dratini, Bagon, Gible and the other first-stage Dragons appear three times as often; your Dragon-types gain 30% more experience.

events.name: Dual-Type Week
events.description: Only the double-typed turn up to play.
events.ruleText: Dual-type Pokémon appear three times as often and single-type ones less than half as often.

events.name: Starter Fever Week
events.description: Starters of every region roam the routes, and yours grows quickly.
events.ruleText: Every region's starters and their evolutions appear three times as often; your starter gains 30% more experience.

objectives.text: Clear 1 region with your starter still in the party

events.name: Baby Pokémon Week
events.description: Nurseries open their doors. Hatchlings are everywhere.
events.ruleText: Baby Pokémon appear four times as often and Eggs hatch with 50% more experience.

events.name: Pseudo-Legend Week
events.description: The 600-point heavyweights wander the routes.
events.ruleText: Three-stage Pokémon with a base stat total of 600 or more appear three times as often.

events.name: Eeveelution Week
events.description: Eevee turns up at every turn, and its family follows.
events.ruleText: Eevee and its evolutions appear six times as often.

events.name: Fossil Week
events.description: Diggers in every cave are turning up revived fossils.
events.ruleText: Fossil Pokémon and their evolutions appear four times as often.

events.name: Valentine's Duo Week
events.description: Pairs are in love with the road: double battles pay more and bonds grow.
events.ruleText: Double battles pay 50% more and Pokémon gain 25% more friendship.

objectives.text: Keep 4 caught Pokémon in your party

events.name: Leap Day Special
events.description: The day that only comes every four years: a mythic is out there somewhere.
events.ruleText: Legendary and Mythical Pokémon appear four times as often and your Pokémon gain 50% more experience.

events.name: Cherry Blossom Picnic
events.description: Picnic blankets under the blossoms: berries, rest and good company.
events.ruleText: Healing items restore 30% more HP and Pokémon gain 50% more friendship.

events.name: Pride Rainbow Parade
events.description: A month-long parade where every type marches together.
events.ruleText: Pokémon gain 25% more friendship and research pays 25% more. Win with six different types in your party for the rainbow goal.

objectives.text: Win 1 run with six different types
Keep 6 caught Pokémon in your party

events.name: Midsummer Night
events.description: The shortest night of the year, bright with fairy lights and fireflies.
events.ruleText: Fairy and Bug-types appear twice as often.

events.name: Fireworks Festival
events.description: Fireworks light the sky at the end of every road.
events.ruleText: Your Pokémon land critical hits 50% more often.

events.name: Autumn Harvest Moon
events.description: The harvest moon hangs low and the berry patches are full.
events.ruleText: Berries and Honey last 50% longer; healing items restore 20% more HP; Grass-types appear 50% more often.

events.name: Thanksgiving Feast
events.description: A long table and a very good meal.
events.ruleText: Berries and Honey last twice as long; healing items restore 25% more HP.

events.name: Black Friday Sale
events.description: Every shop slashes its prices for a few frantic days.
events.ruleText: Everything in shops costs 40% less.

events.name: Winter Solstice
events.description: The longest night. Ghosts and shadows walk freely.
events.ruleText: Ghost and Dark-types appear twice as often.

events.name: Christmas Eve Gift Swap
events.description: Everyone has a surprise to give away.
events.ruleText: Rare and epic rewards turn up 50% more often in drafts and prize money is 10% higher.

events.name: New Moon Night
events.description: No moon tonight: the dark types slip through the shadows.
events.ruleText: Dark and Ghost-types appear twice as often; your Dark-types are 20% harder to hit.

events.name: Full Moon Rise
events.description: The full moon is up and moonlight heals.
events.ruleText: Healing moves (Moonlight and the like) heal 50% more; Fairy and Psychic moves deal 15% more damage.

events.name: Spring Equinox
events.description: Day and night are equal and the whole world is in balance.
events.ruleText: Experience, prize money, research and catching are all 10% better.

events.name: Autumn Equinox
events.description: Leaves turn and the deer wear autumn colours.
events.ruleText: Grass-types appear 50% more often and Deerling and Sawsbuck four times as often.

events.name: Friday the 13th
events.description: Unlucky for some. Very good for ghosts.
events.ruleText: Ghost-types appear three times as often and deal 15% more damage.

events.name: Palindrome Date
events.description: The date reads the same both ways: 11/11, 12/21, 01/10... Mirror matches are about.
events.ruleText: Your Pokémon gain 20% more experience; mirror matches turn up more often.

events.name: Diwali Light Walk
events.description: Lanterns light the way to hidden places on the map.
events.ruleText: The map shows the wild Pokémon waiting at each node; prize money is 15% higher.

events.name: Mid-Autumn Moon Cake
events.description: Moon cakes under a bright moon.
events.ruleText: After each won battle your conscious Pokémon recover 5% of their max HP.

events.name: Day of the Dead Remembrance
events.description: The spirits of fallen friends watch over the road.
events.ruleText: A fatal hit leaves your Pokémon at 1 HP 15% of the time (once per Pokémon per battle); Ghost-types appear twice as often.

events.name: Autumn Brew Fair
events.description: A berry-juice fair with a cup in every hand.
events.ruleText: Berries and Honey last 50% longer and healing items restore 15% more HP.

events.name: Weekend Warm-up
events.description: Every Friday, the weekend starts early.
events.ruleText: Your Pokémon gain double experience all Friday (UTC).

events.name: Legendary Birds Week
events.description: The three legendary birds roam the sky: find their stages and face them.
events.ruleText: Legendary gates for Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres turn up on far more stages (about 1 in 2), skip their usual conditions and one extra is allowed per region.

events.name: Weather Trio Showdown
events.description: Kyogre, Groudon and Rayquaza reshape the sky and sea.
events.ruleText: Legendary gates for Kyogre, Groudon, Rayquaza turn up on far more stages (about 1 in 2), skip their usual conditions and one extra is allowed per region. Weather your side sets up lasts 2 turns longer.

events.name: Creation Trio Week
events.description: Dialga, Palkia and Giratina warp time and space.
events.ruleText: Legendary gates for Dialga, Palkia, Giratina turn up on far more stages (about 1 in 2), skip their usual conditions and one extra is allowed per region.

events.name: Swords of Justice Week
events.description: The four Swords of Justice stand guard on hidden stages.
events.ruleText: Legendary gates for Cobalion, Terrakion, Virizion, Keldeo turn up on far more stages (about 1 in 2), skip their usual conditions and one extra is allowed per region.

events.name: Tao Trio Week
events.description: Reshiram, Zekrom and Kyurem: truth, ideals and the void between.
events.ruleText: Legendary gates for Reshiram, Zekrom, Kyurem turn up on far more stages (about 1 in 2), skip their usual conditions and one extra is allowed per region.

events.name: Mythical Mirage Week
events.description: Mythical Pokémon flicker at the edge of sight.
events.ruleText: Legendary gates for Mew, Celebi, Jirachi, Deoxys, Manaphy, Darkrai, Shaymin, Victini, Meloetta, Genesect, Diancie, Hoopa, Volcanion, Magearna, Marshadow, Zeraora turn up on far more stages (about 1 in 2), skip their usual conditions and one extra is allowed per region.

events.name: Eternatus Vigil
events.description: The sky darkens and something vast stirs above Galar.
events.ruleText: Legendary gates for Eternatus turn up on far more stages (about 1 in 2), skip their usual conditions and one extra is allowed per region. Enemy Hyper moments come 50% more often.

events.name: Paradox Tide
events.description: A tide from the past and future washes the wild pool.
events.ruleText: Paradox Pokémon (Great Tusk to Iron Crown) appear five times as often.

events.name: Gym Leader Rematch Week
events.description: Gym leaders are back, tougher, and better paid.
events.ruleText: Trainers are 1 level higher and bosses pay 50% more prize money.

events.name: Elite Four Sweep
events.description: Beat all four, one after another, for the best score.
events.ruleText: Elite Four members are 2 levels higher and bosses pay 50% more prize money.

events.name: Champion Cup Weekend
events.description: Past champions step up for a cup of their own.
events.ruleText: Champion battles pay triple prize money.

events.name: Rival Gauntlet
events.description: Every rival wants a word. Face them all in one run.
events.ruleText: Rivals are 1 level higher.

events.name: Team Rocket Invasion
events.description: Rocket grunts are on every road.
events.ruleText: The evil team of your run is Rocket (by seed). Poison-types appear 50% more often.

events.name: Team Aqua vs Team Magma Showdown
events.description: Land and sea clash; one of them is behind it.
events.ruleText: The evil team of your run is one of Aqua and Magma (by seed). Water and Fire-types appear 50% more often.

events.name: Team Galactic Machination
events.description: Galactic is bending time and space for its plan.
events.ruleText: The evil team of your run is Galactic (by seed). Psychic-types appear 50% more often.

events.name: Team Plasma Liberation
events.description: Plasma preaches freedom for Pokémon. Is it true?
events.ruleText: The evil team of your run is Plasma (by seed). Pokémon gain 25% more friendship.

events.name: Team Flare Experiment
events.description: Flare tests Mega Stones in secret labs.
events.ruleText: The evil team of your run is Flare (by seed). Mega Evolved Pokémon deal 15% more damage.

events.name: Aether Foundation Rescue
events.description: Rescue Pokémon from the Aether labs.
events.ruleText: The evil team of your run is Aether (by seed). Poké Balls work 15% better.

events.name: Z-Move Trial
events.description: Trial captains test your Z-Moves.
events.ruleText: Z-Moves deal 25% more damage.

events.name: Mega Evolution Showcase
events.description: Mega Stones are cheap to craft and Megas shine.
events.ruleText: Mega Evolved Pokémon deal 20% more damage and crafting Mega Stones costs half.

objectives.text: Win 2 battles after a Mega Evolution

events.name: Grand Opening Sale
events.description: A new shop opens in every town with fresh stock.
events.ruleText: Shops cost 10% less and restock twice as often.

events.name: Berry Bonanza
events.description: Every berry stall in the region is overflowing.
events.ruleText: Berries and Honey last 50% longer and healing items restore 30% more HP.

events.name: TM Tuesday
events.description: Every Tuesday the TM vendors come to town.
events.ruleText: The TM Vendor turns up more often on the map all Tuesday (UTC).

events.name: Held-Item Hurricane
events.description: Held items fall from the sky.
events.ruleText: Rare and epic rewards turn up twice as often in drafts.

events.name: Coupon Week
events.description: Coupons come attached to every purchase.
events.ruleText: Everything in shops costs 15% less.

events.name: Bankruptcy Sale
events.description: The shopkeeper must sell everything now.
events.ruleText: Everything in shops costs half and 3 more locked entries are for sale early.

events.name: Prize Wheel Weekend
events.description: Win a battle, spin the wheel.
events.ruleText: Prize money from ordinary trainer battles is 30% higher.

events.name: Lottery Draw
events.description: Weekly run tickets: feel lucky?
events.ruleText: Every run starts with 10 extra Luck.

events.name: Black Market Week
events.description: Shady stalls with cursed and powerful goods.
events.ruleText: Shops also sell stock your badges have not opened yet, at double the price.

events.name: Inflation Day
events.description: Prices climb, but the drops are better.
events.ruleText: Everything in shops costs 30% more; prize money is 40% higher and rare rewards turn up 30% more often.

events.name: Pokémart Loyalty Points
events.description: Spend gold, earn points, win a rare gift.
events.ruleText: Spend money at shops to earn points toward a bank credit gift.

events.name: Trade-In Week
events.description: Swap spare Pokémon for goods; trading posts everywhere.
events.ruleText: Trading posts and traders turn up more often on the map.

events.name: Hardcore Hour
events.description: Bosses hit harder, and pay triple.
events.ruleText: Damage you take from gym leaders, Elite Four members and champions is 25% higher; their prize money is tripled.

events.name: Solo Hero Week
events.description: One Pokémon, one road, one hero.
events.ruleText: Your party holds only one Pokémon (Solo Run rule), with 40% more HP, Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed.

events.name: Critical Week
events.description: Everything lands right on the weak spot.
events.ruleText: Your Pokémon land critical hits twice as often.

events.name: No Items Week
events.description: The bag is locked. Only Poké Balls go in battle.
events.ruleText: Only Poké Balls can be used in battle (Empty Bag rule); after each won battle your Pokémon recover 5% of their max HP.

events.name: No Healing Week
events.description: Healing stops are closed; only the Pokémon Centers can help.
events.ruleText: Healing stops on the map cannot be used (No Healing Stops rule); prize money is 20% higher.

events.name: Glass Cannon Week
events.description: All the power, none of the toughness.
events.ruleText: Your Pokémon have 30% more Attack and Sp. Atk and 30% less HP.

events.name: Giant Week
events.description: Everything is huge and slow.
events.ruleText: Your Pokémon have 20% more HP and 15% less Speed.

events.name: Only Starters Week
events.description: The wild routes are full of starter lines.
events.ruleText: Starter Pokémon of every region and their evolutions appear ten times as often.

events.name: Only Fully Evolved Week
events.description: No half measures: the evolved only, and tougher.
events.ruleText: Fully evolved Pokémon appear six times as often and unevolved ones a fifth as often; trainers are 1 level higher.

events.name: Only Unevolved Week
events.description: Little ones everywhere; show what a Pichu can do.
events.ruleText: Pokémon that can still evolve appear six times as often and fully evolved ones less than a third as often.

events.name: Gravity Week
events.description: The ground pulls hard: nothing floats today.
events.ruleText: Gravity is on at the start of every fight (5 turns): Flying-types and levitating Pokémon lose their ground immunity.

events.name: Trick Room Week
events.description: The slow go first, everywhere.
events.ruleText: Trick Room is on at the start of every fight (5 turns): slower Pokémon move first.

events.name: Tailwind Week
events.description: A steady wind at your back.
events.ruleText: Your side starts every fight with Tailwind (5 turns): double Speed.

events.name: Gen 1 Throwback
events.description: A throwback to Kanto: its Pokémon crowd the routes.
events.ruleText: Generation 1 Pokémon appear eight times as often.

events.name: Gen 3 Throwback
events.description: A throwback to Hoenn: its Pokémon crowd the routes.
events.ruleText: Generation 3 Pokémon appear eight times as often.

events.name: Gen 5 Throwback
events.description: A throwback to Unova: its Pokémon crowd the routes.
events.ruleText: Generation 5 Pokémon appear eight times as often.

events.name: Treasure Map Week
events.description: Old maps, buried chests and a hidden prize.
events.ruleText: Prize money is 15% higher. The listed map events turn up more often. The chart seller is about with Treasure Maps.

events.name: Caravan Week
events.description: A caravan follows the road, selling and trading.
events.ruleText: Everything in shops costs 10% less. The listed map events turn up more often. Travelling trainers tag along.

events.name: Weather Map Week
events.description: The forecast tells you where the storms are.
events.ruleText: The map shows the wild Pokémon waiting at each node. The listed map events turn up more often.

events.name: Cave Expedition Week
events.description: Underground routes and rare ores.
events.ruleText: Rock and Ground-types appear 50% more often. The listed map events turn up more often. Dark caves and boulders block more paths.

events.name: Island Hopping Week
events.description: Ferries link the islands.
events.ruleText: Water-types appear 50% more often. The listed map events turn up more often. Lakes cut the islands apart: bring a surfer.

events.name: Volcano Eruption
events.description: The volcano is waking up.
events.ruleText: Fire and Rock-types appear 50% more often and Fire moves deal 10% more damage. The listed map events turn up more often. Lava rivers and wildfires cross the map.

events.name: Earthquake Tremors
events.description: The ground keeps shaking and the paths shift.
events.ruleText: Ground-types appear 50% more often. The listed map events turn up more often. Fresh rockslides and cracked walls block the roads, and every 3 nodes a tremor swaps two stops ahead.

events.name: Flood Event
events.description: The rivers are over their banks.
events.ruleText: Water-types appear twice as often. The listed map events turn up more often. Flooded lakes and rivers cut the land routes.

events.name: Blizzard Week
events.description: A snowstorm closes the passes.
events.ruleText: Ice-types appear 50% more often and your hail lasts 2 turns longer. The listed map events turn up more often. Snowdrifts lock some stops until a Fire or Ground-type clears them.

events.name: Heat Wave
events.description: Shimmering heat over every road.
events.ruleText: Fire moves deal 15% more damage and Fire-types appear 50% more often. The listed map events turn up more often. Wildfires break out on the road.

events.name: Aurora Night
events.description: The aurora lights the north.
events.ruleText: Ice-types appear three times as often and rare Pokémon 50% more often. The listed map events turn up more often.

events.name: Safari Zone Week
events.description: Walk the Safari and catch what you can.
events.ruleText: Poké Balls work 30% better. The listed map events turn up more often. Follow the tracks through the long grass.

events.name: Bug Contest Day
events.description: Net the biggest bug you can find.
events.ruleText: Bug-types appear three times as often and catching pays 50% more. The listed map events turn up more often.

events.name: Pokéathlon Day
events.description: Athletic stops on the road.
events.ruleText: Your Pokémon have 5% more Speed. The listed map events turn up more often.

events.name: Underground Week
events.description: Dig for what is buried.
events.ruleText: Prize money is 10% higher and rare rewards turn up 30% more often. The listed map events turn up more often. Earthen walls hide tunnels for a Ground-type to dig.

events.name: Ruins Expedition
events.description: Decode glyphs and wake old guardians.
events.ruleText: Research pays 25% more. The listed map events turn up more often. Puzzle rooms and silent statues fill the ruins.

events.name: Sunken Ship Dive
events.description: Dive down to the wreck.
events.ruleText: Water and Ghost-types appear 50% more often. The listed map events turn up more often. Dive spots with an oxygen meter lead down to the wreck.

events.name: Sky Tower Climb
events.description: Up and up, to the top of the sky.
events.ruleText: Flying-types appear twice as often. The listed map events turn up more often. The map climbs like a tower, with a healing checkpoint every 5 levels; cliffs and cloud gaps need a flyer.

events.name: Magical Forest Maze
events.description: The forest rearranges itself around you.
events.ruleText: Grass and Fairy-types appear 50% more often. The listed map events turn up more often. Every stage has a looping forest clearing to find the way out of; fairy rings lead to hidden groves.

events.name: Ghost Town Visit
events.description: Every stop has a ghost with a story.
events.ruleText: Ghost-types appear twice as often. The listed map events turn up more often. Spectral doors only Ghost-types can open.

events.name: Festival Street
events.description: Stalls and games every few nodes.
events.ruleText: Prize money is 10% higher. The listed map events turn up more often. Arcade cabinets hide behind the stalls.

events.name: Lighthouse Beacon
events.description: The beacon shows the way.
events.ruleText: The map shows the wild Pokémon waiting at each node. The listed map events turn up more often. Beacon fires light the road ahead.

events.name: Roadside Rival Week
events.description: A rival can jump out at any time.
events.ruleText: Rivals are 1 level higher. The listed map events turn up more often. Somebody is following you.

events.name: Map Mutator Week
events.description: Every stage is full of obstacles and odd places.
events.ruleText: Three more traversal obstacles on every stage, of every kind. The listed map events turn up more often.

events.name: Train Ride Special
events.description: Express trains run on every route.
events.ruleText: Shops cost 5% less. The listed map events turn up more often.

events.name: Shiny Charm Day
events.description: One bright day when the sparkle comes easier.
events.ruleText: Shiny odds are tripled for wild Pokémon, event gifts and Eggs.

events.name: Friendship Level Week
events.description: Bonds grow twice as fast.
events.ruleText: Pokémon gain double friendship.

objectives.text: Keep 6 caught Pokémon in your party

events.name: Evolution Festival
events.description: Everything wants to evolve.
events.ruleText: Pokémon evolve 3 levels sooner.

events.name: Mega Stone Hunt
events.description: Mega Stones are out there: dig them up, craft them, find them in the bazaar.
events.ruleText: Crafting Mega Stones costs half, rare and epic rewards turn up twice as often, and Mega Evolved Pokémon deal 10% more damage.

objectives.text: Win 2 battles after a Mega Evolution

events.name: Move Tutor Tour
events.description: Tutors visit every town.
events.ruleText: Move tutors, TM vendors and move forgetters turn up more often.

events.name: EV Boot Camp
events.description: Train a stat at the camp stops.
events.ruleText: Training stops turn up more often.

events.name: Contest Spectacular
events.description: Pokémon Contests as a side event.
events.ruleText: Contest halls, beauty pageants and showy stops turn up more often.

events.name: Pokémon Photography Week
events.description: Photo spots all over the map.
events.ruleText: Photo shoots and scenic stops turn up more often.
